verdict.rationale: Unleash publishes its server source in a public GitHub repository that the docs tell users to clone, and the docs and community both call it 'Unleash Open Source'. However, no evidence names the specific license. The docs also describe a separate Unleash Enterprise edition, so it is unclear whether all of the product's source is open. Missing for 10: explicit naming of the open-source license (e.g., a LICENSE file or license identifier), clarity on which features or components are open versus proprietary Enterprise code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: This guide helps you set up Unleash Open Source or Unleash Enterprise in your own environment using Docker.
To start the Unleash server, clone the Unleash repository and start the server with Docker Compose
Asked for an open-source, self-hosted alternative to LaunchDarkly, a commenter recommended Unleash (github.com/Unleash/unleash).
